items.name: AWS CDK
items.description: Framework that lets developers define cloud infrastructure using familiar programming languages, which is then synthesized into CloudFormation templates for deployment.

items.name: AWS CloudFormation
items.description: AWS service for provisioning and managing cloud resources using declarative JSON or YAML templates, enabling infrastructure as code.

items.name: Azure Resource Manager Templates
items.description: JSON-based declarative templates used to define and deploy Azure resources in a consistent, repeatable way.

items.name: Bicep
items.description: Domain-specific language for deploying Azure resources declaratively, offering simpler syntax than raw ARM JSON templates while compiling down to them.

items.name: Packer
items.description: Tool for creating identical machine images for multiple platforms (cloud, virtualization, containers) from a single source configuration.

items.name: Pulumi
items.description: Infrastructure as code platform that lets teams define and manage cloud resources using general-purpose programming languages instead of a dedicated DSL.

items.name: Terraform
items.description: Infrastructure as code tool that uses a declarative configuration language to provision and manage resources across many cloud and on-premises providers.
